$comment: Hand-reviewed corrections applied on top of the automatic path classification (scripts/lib/library.mjs#classify). Keyed by app id.

whatsapp-business.reason: WhatsApp: self-serve app, but Business Verification + App Review gate production

shopify.reason: Shopify: public distribution needs App Store review

bigcommerce.reason: BigCommerce: marketplace approval needed to reach all merchants

snowflake.reason: Snowflake: each customer admin creates the security integration; no central OAuth app

sentry.reason: Sentry: publishing an integration triggers Sentry review

smartsheet.reason: Smartsheet: developer registration can be denied

quickbooks.reason: QuickBooks: production keys need the app assessment questionnaire

close.reason: Close: OAuth apps stay private to your organization until Close approves them (Make Public → review)
